summary.name: ClashBar
summary.one_liner: ClashBar is a native macOS menu bar client built on the mihomo proxy core for importing configs, switching nodes, and managing system proxy and TUN from a compact panel.
use_cases: manage proxy nodes from the macOS menu bar
import local YAML or remote subscription configs
switch between Rule, Global and Direct proxy modes
monitor live traffic speed and active connections
take over traffic with system proxy or TUN mode
remotely manage a mihomo instance on a NAS or VPS
summary.what_it_does: ClashBar is a menu bar proxy client for macOS that wraps the mihomo kernel. Its panel covers config import (local YAML or remote subscriptions), node selection with latency tests, and system proxy and TUN control. It shows upload and download rates, connection count, memory use and the current mode in both the menu bar and the panel. Users can switch Rule, Global and Direct modes from the menu bar or with a shortcut, view and close connections, and browse rule counts and hit distribution. The page also describes remote management of mihomo instances on a home NAS, Docker, or a VPS.
notable: Native SwiftUI + AppKit app with zero third-party dependencies, about 3 MB package
Bundles the mihomo core (about 14 MB with core), Meta ecosystem compatible
Supports local YAML, remote subscriptions, system proxy and TUN
Installable via Homebrew or DMG; GPL-3.0 licensed
caveats: Page advises quitting other Clash-family clients first to avoid conflicts over system proxy and ports
If the system proxy toggle does not respond, background activity in Login Items may need checking
